name: 37083 · Lafayette, TN
findings: ZIP 37083 (Lafayette) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37083 (Lafayette) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37083 (Lafayette) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37083 (Lafayette) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
